resources.string: Turn these on so the app can do its job:
Lets Scroll Budget detect when Instagram/YouTube is in the foreground, so it can track daily usage.
Stay off social media -- your streak is just starting…

Add your own free Gemini API key (from aistudio.google.com, no credit card needed) to get a short, personalized motivation message based on your current streak. Your key stays on this device and is only sent directly to Google\'s API.
Paste your free Gemini API key here
Set your own reminders. Your phone will vibrate strongly when the scheduled time arrives.
